decks.module: Rural roads and limited night vision

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Stay alert on quiet rural” and ends with “hazards rather than relaxing attention”?
cards.back: Stay alert on quiet rural roads, watch warnings and reduce speed for hazards rather than relaxing attention.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Gravel and dirt provide less” and ends with “following space for longer stops”?
cards.back: Gravel and dirt provide less grip than concrete or asphalt; slow down and increase following space for longer stops.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Potholes and rippled gravel” and ends with “disturb steering and control”?
cards.back: Potholes and rippled gravel or dirt surfaces can disturb steering and control.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “In dust on gravel roads,” and ends with “and leave more following room”?
cards.back: In dust on gravel roads, use low beams to improve visibility to others, slow down and leave more following room.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Narrow rural roads may have” and ends with “to stop for opposing traffic”?
cards.back: Narrow rural roads may have little shoulder and steep nearby ditches; watch narrow-bridge warnings and prepare to stop for opposing traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Slow and increase following room” and ends with “unexpected dips or sharp bends”?
cards.back: Slow and increase following room on rural roads with unexpected dips or sharp bends.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Open metal bridge gratings reduce” and ends with “firmly and increase following room”?
cards.back: Open metal bridge gratings reduce braking and steering grip; slow, hold the wheel firmly and increase following room.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Trees and tall” and ends with “near rural corners”?
cards.back: Trees and tall crops can hide traffic near rural corners.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Before a rural hillcrest or” and ends with “and watch for opposing vehicles”?
cards.back: Before a rural hillcrest or sharp curve, slow down, keep to the right and watch for opposing vehicles.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “At rural railroad crossings, slow,” and ends with “signs without gates or lights”?
cards.back: At rural railroad crossings, slow, look both ways and prepare to stop because a crossing may have signs without gates or lights.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Approach uncontrolled rural intersections cautiously” and ends with “for crossing or opposing traffic”?
cards.back: Approach uncontrolled rural intersections cautiously at lower speed and be ready to stop for crossing or opposing traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “At night, headlights reveal less” and ends with “daylight, making driving more difficult”?
cards.back: At night, headlights reveal less of the road than daylight, making driving more difficult.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook recommends dimming high” and ends with “before meeting an opposing vehicle”?
cards.back: The handbook recommends dimming high beams about one block before meeting an opposing vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “If an opposing driver uses” and ends with “toward the road's right side”?
cards.back: If an opposing driver uses high beams, a single brief headlight flash may request dimming; if glare continues, look toward the road's right side.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not retaliate against high” and ends with “vehicle's own high beams on”?
cards.back: Do not retaliate against high beams by keeping the vehicle's own high beams on.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Use low beams when following” and ends with “fog, snowfall or heavy rain”?
cards.back: Use low beams when following another vehicle or driving in heavy traffic, fog, snowfall or heavy rain.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “High-beam light reflected by adverse” and ends with “in fog, snow or rain”?
cards.back: High-beam light reflected by adverse weather can create glare; equipped vehicles may use fog lights in fog, snow or rain.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Avoid staring into approaching” and ends with “can briefly impair vision”?
cards.back: Avoid staring into approaching headlights because glare can briefly impair vision.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “At night, search far ahead” and ends with “road edges for side hazards”?
cards.back: At night, search far ahead for dark shapes and occasionally check both road edges for side hazards.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not use sunglasses or” and ends with “because they reduce useful vision”?
cards.back: Do not use sunglasses or tinted glasses at night or on dark days because they reduce useful vision.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Flooding may follow overflowing waterways,” and ends with “flash floods can develop rapidly”?
cards.back: Flooding may follow overflowing waterways, failed dams or levees, melting snow runoff or rainfall, and flash floods can develop rapidly.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not drive into a” and ends with “around and choose another route”?
cards.back: Do not drive into a flooded road; turn around and choose another route.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not attempt a flooded” and ends with “washed-out roadbed may be present”?
cards.back: Do not attempt a flooded crossing even if it looks shallow because hidden dips or a washed-out roadbed may be present.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “If no alternative flood-free route” and ends with “wait for water to recede”?
cards.back: If no alternative flood-free route exists, move to higher ground and wait for water to recede.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Work zones may include lane” and ends with “or long-term at any season”?
cards.back: Work zones may include lane closures, detours or moving equipment and can be temporary or long-term at any season.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Cones, barrels, signs, large vehicles” and ends with “zone and guide its traffic”?
cards.back: Cones, barrels, signs, large vehicles and workers in bright clothing can signal a work zone and guide its traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Orange work-zone signs” and ends with “and speed information”?
cards.back: Orange work-zone signs convey instructions, advance notice and speed information.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Without a reduced work-zone” and ends with “posted limit still applies”?
cards.back: Without a reduced work-zone limit, the ordinary posted limit still applies.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “In work zones, monitor surrounding” and ends with “needed and increase following space”?
cards.back: In work zones, monitor surrounding traffic, obey signs and flaggers, reduce speed as needed and increase following space.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Work-zone lane patterns may” and ends with “ignore familiar long-term signs”?
cards.back: Work-zone lane patterns may change daily; do not ignore familiar long-term signs.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook recommends moving to” and ends with “approaching work zone when possible”?
cards.back: The handbook recommends moving to the appropriate lane at the first notice of an approaching work zone when possible.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Use added caution at night” and ends with “even when workers are absent”?
cards.back: Use added caution at night in a work zone even when workers are absent.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “When possible, position the vehicle” and ends with “occupied by workers or equipment”?
cards.back: When possible, position the vehicle away from the side occupied by workers or equipment.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Some roadwork moves along the” and ends with “signs until the end-of-work notice”?
cards.back: Some roadwork moves along the road, including painting, patching and mowing; continue obeying signs until the end-of-work notice.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Allow extra travel time for” and ends with “an alternate route when possible”?
cards.back: Allow extra travel time for work-zone delays or choose an alternate route when possible.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not swerve into opposing” and ends with “road to avoid an animal”?
cards.back: Do not swerve into opposing traffic or off the road to avoid an animal.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An abrupt animal-avoidance maneuver may” and ends with “before, during and after impact”?
cards.back: An abrupt animal-avoidance maneuver may cause a more severe crash; maintaining vehicle control is the priority before, during and after impact.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook recommends additional animal” and ends with “and during October through December”?
cards.back: The handbook recommends additional animal caution at dawn and dusk and during October through December.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Be alert at deer-crossing signs,” and ends with “a history of deer-vehicle collisions”?
cards.back: Be alert at deer-crossing signs, which identify areas with a history of deer-vehicle collisions.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Search well ahead and to” and ends with “night near woods and water”?
cards.back: Search well ahead and to both sides for animals, including reflected eye shine at night near woods and water.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Slow near roadside animals because” and ends with “and other deer may follow”?
cards.back: Slow near roadside animals because they may change direction abruptly and other deer may follow.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Hazard flashers can warn other” and ends with “on or beside the road”?
cards.back: Hazard flashers can warn other drivers of animals on or beside the road.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “When time permits avoiding an” and ends with “followers and use the horn”?
cards.back: When time permits avoiding an animal, reduce speed, tap the brakes to warn followers and use the horn.
cards.memory_hook: Keep the licensing path distinct.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “With no vehicle close behind,” and ends with “avoiding wheel lock and skidding”?
cards.back: With no vehicle close behind, the handbook permits hard braking to avoid an animal while avoiding wheel lock and skidding.
cards.memory_hook: Keep the licensing path distinct.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “If striking an animal is” and ends with “the road rather than swerving”?
cards.back: If striking an animal is unavoidable, keep control and remain on the road rather than swerving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Report a collision with a” and ends with “or farm animal, to police”?
cards.back: Report a collision with a large animal, such as a deer or farm animal, to police.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “If a struck animal is” and ends with “possible without entering anyone's home”?
cards.back: If a struck animal is a pet and homes are nearby, try to notify its owner when possible without entering anyone's home.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Pets can enter the” and ends with “rural and farm areas”?
cards.back: Pets can enter the roadway in residential, rural and farm areas.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.
